description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the performance ratio of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the "Ratio (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—in left-to-right order. For each category, three bars are grouped side-by-side, corresponding to the three models. In the "Movies" category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 90%, the Qwen2 bar is slightly above 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 72%. In the "Songs" category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 63%. In the "Basketball" category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 67%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 61%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories as labeled on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard presentation.
